snippet.title: Misc  A Tiny Tale | Frosty Games Fest 2025
snippet.description:
Featured in Frosty Games Fest 2025! Watch the full showcase here: https://youtu.be/3ff3YxX7Cgw

Take a brand-new look at this pint-sized adventure where you play as a tiny robot made of miscellaneous parts. Glimpse Misc. A Tiny Tale in even greater detail with this new Release Date trailer showing off exploration and cleaning gameplay, plus a look at some of the unique and memorable robots you’ll meet on your adventure – and of course, a July 22nd launch date on Steam and Nintendo Switch!

Wishlist:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/1308940/Misc_A_Tiny_Tale/ 

Find more games made in Australia and Aotearoa New Zealand on our Steam event page here: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45423962/sale/FrostyGamesCelebration
